blocks.title: Electronegativity
blocks.text: Electronegativity molecule mein kisi atom ki mushtarak (shared) electron jore ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat hai.

Linus Pauling, ek American chemist, ne be-ikai (dimensionless) electronegativity qeematon ka pemana banaya, jo alkali metals ke liye ek se zara kam se fluorine ke liye zyada se zyada chaar tak hai. Zyada qeemat electrons ke liye zyada mazboot kashish zahir karti hai.
Electronegativity par asar dalne wale awamil

items: Atomic jasamat: bara atom kam electronegativity rakhta hai, kyunke nucleus se door electrons kamzor kashish mehsoos karte hain. Group 17 ke halogens F zyada Cl zyada Br zyada I chalte hain.

Moassar nuclear charge: zyada moassar nuclear charge zyada electronegativity deta hai, kyunke barha hua charge bandhe electrons ko zyada mazbooti se kheenchta hai; isi liye electronegativity period mein barhti hai. Period 2 mein lithium 1.0 aur fluorine 4.0 rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Linus Pauling wahid shakhs hai jise do akele (unshared) Nobel inaam mile: 1954 mein chemistry ka kimiyai bond ki noiyat par kaam ke liye, aur 1962 mein aman ka bare paimane par tabahi ke hathiyaron ki mukhalifat ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur ya chlorine mein kis ki electronegativity zyada hai, aur kyun? Aur chlorine aur bromine mein?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine ki electronegativity sulfur se zyada hai kyunke yeh usi period mein sulfur ke baad zyada moassar nuclear charge aur chhote atom ke saath aati hai, to bandhe electrons ko zyada mazbooti se kheenchti hai. Chlorine bromine se bhi aage hai, jo group mein us ke neeche aur bara hai, to us ke bandhe electrons kamzor kheench mehsoos karte hain.

items: Electronegativity molecule mein atom ki mushtarak electron jore ko kheenchne ki taqat hai; Pauling ka be-ikai pemana 1 se zara kam (alkali metals) se 4 (fluorine) tak hai.
Bare atoms ke liye kam (F zyada Cl zyada Br zyada I), zyada moassar nuclear charge ke liye zyada (period 2 mein Li 1.0 se F 4.0).
